steps.body: Hundreds add just like ones: 3 hundreds and 2 hundreds make 5 hundreds. The place holds, only the count grows.
steps.narration: Hundreds add just like ones: 3 hundreds and 2 hundreds make 5 hundreds. The place holds, only the count grows.

commonBuilds.feedback: Four flats build 400 — one hundred short of the join of 300 and 200.

widget.missFeedback: That build names a different number — total each unit's worth and match 500 exactly.
widget.successFeedback: Five flats — 3 hundreds joined with 2 more make 5 hundreds, 500.

predict.reveal: Whole hundreds touch only the hundreds place; tens and ones stay zero.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2b add hundreds.
invariants: Trading between places changes the FORM of a quantity, never its value — the model and the number must stay equal for g2b add hundreds.
misconceptions: Treating a trade as adding or removing amount instead of renaming the same total.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the blocks stop matching the written number?

commonErrors.feedback: That added 1 ones instead of 1 hundreds — the second addend is whole hundreds.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Line the places up — hundreds with hundreds, tens with tens, ones with ones — and work one column at a time.

options.feedback: An estimate trades exactness for speed on purpose; the exact sum is the second step.
